titleEn: The future: will and going to
explanationAr: نستخدم going to لخطة قررناها من قبل: We are going to replace the pipe next week. ونستخدم will لقرار نتخذه الآن، أو لوعد، أو لتوقّع: I will call you later. The test will take two hours. وبعد will يأتي الفعل في صورته الأساسية، دون to ودون s: She will send it، وليس will sends ولا will to send.
explanationEn: Use going to for a plan you made before: We are going to replace the pipe next week. Use will for a decision you make now, a promise, or a prediction: I will call you later. The test will take two hours. After will, use the base verb, with no to and no -s: She will send it.

comparison.en: We are going to replace the pipe next week.

examples.en: I will send you the file after lunch.
We are going to visit the site on Sunday.
The new road will reduce traffic.
Are you going to attend the meeting?
